high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a presentation during the Romanes Lectures at the University of Oxford. The slide is titled "Abandoning a fundamental principle" and discusses the evolution of digital computers and their programming methods. Title: Abandoning a fundamental principle Points: Digital computers are designed to be programmed by people, which is why they need to follow instructions precisely. We now have a different way of getting a general-purpose computer to perform particular computational tasks: Learn from examples.
